t: , (accord. to a MS. copy of the K, and accord. to to the CK,) and
he put himself in motion and went away.
Such a one does not put himself in motion for
There is not in him strength
having his bridle pulled in, and being put in motion,
putting himself in motion to run.
, with, damm, [app. as an inf. n.,] also signifies the act of
affair; he declined from it; he avoided it;
retired to a distance, and separated himself, from him,
turned away and fled, from his opponent,
retired to a distance, from him.
(A) And it is said in the Kur, [xxxviii. 2,]
When it was not a time of fleeing:
when it was not a time of drawing back and fleeing:
when it was not a time of seeking,
(S, M, K;) because he ceases not to raise his head, going to and fro, like one running away at random. (Lth, K. *)
Raising his head, and running away at random:
raising his head, and going to and fro, like one running away at random:
A place to which one has recourse for refuge, protection, preservation,
a place to which one flees;

maqayis: النون والواو والصاد أصل صحيح يدل على تردد ومجيء وذهاب. وناص عن قرنه ينوص نوصا. والمناص المصدر، والملجأ أيضا. قال سبحانه: {ولات حين مناص} [ص: 3] . ويقولون: النوص: الحمار الوحشي لا يزال نائصا: رافعا رأسه، يتردد كالجامح. وناوص الجرة: مارسها. ومر تفسيره في باب الجيم.
mufradat: ناص إلى كذا: التجأ إليه، وناص عنه: ارتد، ينوص نوصا، والمناص: الملجأ. قال تعالى: ولات حين مناص [ص/ 3] .
